properties.site-address: Former Builders Yard and Office, Union Street, Blyth
properties.notes: Vacant land and buildings previously occupied by a builders yard. The site will require clearance, including demolition of redundant buildings, prior to redevelopment. Higher density and yield is fitting for urban location, reflecting a proposal for flats/apartments. A previous planning permission for 23 homes was granted but this lapsed without being started (B/09/00008/FUL). The current availability of the site is uncertain. There still may be potential in the long-term but no residential development is forecast within the plan period at present.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
